incidents.name: Polter Finance BOO spot-price manipulation
incidents.notes: Polter's Aave-fork lending pool priced BOO collateral from the SpookySwap V3 WFTM/BOO pool's spot state, so emptying that pool with its own flash loan let the attacker deposit a handful of BOO at an inflated valuation and borrow out every other market.

sources.ref: onchain review on Fantom over a public RPC (no explorer creation API): binary search over eth_getCode places the lending pool 0x867fAa51b3A437B4E2e699945590Ef4f2be2a6d5 first having code at block 74897880, 2024-01-29T17:18:17Z; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events between then and the incident, so the executing code was 292.0 days old. The attack-tx sender is 0x511f427cdf0c4e463655856db382e05d79ac44a6. Reported loss $7M.

re-check 2026 (deployment-basis rows with a DELEGATECALL in the runtime): CONFIRMED deployment basis. Aave-fork InitializableImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy: EIP-1967 implementation slot constant at 0xd47ae558623638f676c1e38dad71b53054f54273 over a 25-point probe of [74897880, 97508839], and that implementation's runtime is constant over the same window. Its delegatecall targets are the link-time libraries 0x89e0348cd2196a2903a853379b7420b4ca390a08 and 0x5ebd3d0112c4c6a67d4381557618a0424a998de1 (both runtimes begin 73<self>3014 and are constant) plus the addresses-provider-resolved LendingPoolCollateralManager: eth_call of getLendingPoolCollateralManager() on 0x975EC106fBedA5551377cc5A97203493A2374e6e returns 0xBF103332800dd4696a9c9152603870B118C480e2 unchanged at 21 sample points across the window, with that contract's code also constant. (The public Fantom archive does not serve debug_traceTransaction, so the storage probes stand alone here.)
